name: Michael C. McNeil
biography: Michael C. McNeil is a noted privacy and security expert who leads the Global Product Security and Services organization at Philips Healthcare. In this capacity, McNeil leads the global product security and data protection program for the company. He is also a member of the Visual Privacy Advisory Council (VPAC) , Medical Device Privacy Consortium (MDPC), Medical Device Innovation, Safety and Services Consortium (MDISS) and a frequent speaker at privacy and security conferences around the world.
